result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk and curb ramps, but it lacks a pedestrian refuge island. The significant crossing distance and car-centric scale create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to vehicle traffic for an extended period without a break.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: There is no median or refuge island to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians mid-crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and provide a safe haven.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features wide sidewalks and curb ramps with tactile warnings, but lacks marked crosswalks across a multi-lane roadway. While pedestrian signals are present, the overall design prioritizes vehicle throughput over pedestrian protection.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: Despite the presence of curb ramps and pedestrian signals, there are no painted markings to define the crossing path for pedestrians or alert drivers.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic without any mid-crossing refuge.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Install ladder or continental style markings to clearly define the pedestrian path and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corner to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential street with sidewalks on both sides, though they lack a buffer from the roadway. There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian safety features visible, and parked cars significantly obstruct sightlines for anyone attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Continuous lines of parked cars on both sides of the street block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the visible street

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks at intersections or mid-block increases the risk for pedestrians crossing the street.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at intersections to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near intersections and potential crossing points to improve sight lines.
